Luther Burden will aim to recover from a concussion ahead of Chicago's Week 11 game against the Saints. Burden got concussed in the fourth quarter of a Week 9 win over the Buccaneers before the Bears' bye week, so hopefully he's had enough time to heal. The second-year star has now posted a 49-644-4 receiving line across nine games with career highs in catches and touchdowns, with one more game likely to get him over the hump in yards as well. If he's active, Burden will face a New Orleans defense that's ranked a tough eighth in fantasy points allowed to WRs.

news.text: Bears head coach Ben Johnson confirmed Tuesday that Burden has cleared concussion protocol, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.. Burden's status was up in the air for a bit with the Bears going on bye immediately after he sustained a concussion in a Week 9 win over the  Buccaneers, but he was spotted working out on the field with teammates Monday and has apparently cleared all five phases of the protocol. The second-year wideout looks like he'll be a full practice participant throughout Week 11, and he shouldn't face any playing-time limitations in Sunday's game versus the Saints.

players.outlook: Kirk Cousins will take the reins again as the Vikings take on the 49ers in Week 11. Cousins shone in his Week 10 return to Minnesota, completing 68 percent of passes for 207 yards with a 2:1 TD:INT. The veteran will look to regain his form even more with his old squad this week ahead of what could be a tough matchup in Mexico City. The 49ers have ranked 14th in fantasy points allowed to QBs so far this season.

Ashton Jeanty failed to generate much production in the Raiders' Week 10 loss to the Seahawks, gaining 18 rushing yards on nine carries and catching all four of his targets for 46 yards. It's the sixth time in the last seven games he's generated more yards through the air than on the ground, but his hold on the No. 1 job in the backfield may have tightened a bit with Mike Washington struggling over the last two weeks as well. Jeanty's outlook as a pass-catcher could improve if Brock Bowers misses time due to an ankle injury. During the two games the star tight end sat out at the beginning of t

Tyler Bass faces unsettled scoring chances when the Bills host the Dolphins in Week 11. After attempting multiple field goals in five straight games, Bass tried just one in Week 10 with Buffalo coasting to a win and converting drives into touchdowns. That script seems likely to manifest again in Week 11 against an overmatched Miami defense, so while Bass will have a multi-PAT floor, his ceiling could be capped.

news.text: Bass made his sole field-goal attempt and all four PATs in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.. Bass made a 37-yard field goal in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker continues his perfect streak, having made all 20 of his field-goal attempts so far in 2026, with three such conversions coming from beyond 50 yards.

players.outlook: Tre Tucker didn't show much chemistry with Fernando Mendoza in the rookie quarterback's first NFL start, catching just one of two targets for nine yards in the Raiders' Week 10 loss to the Seahawks. He remains the team's top wide receiver, and with Brock Bowers now dealing with an ankle injury, there could be less competition for targets in the short term. Tucker produced a 34-538-4 line on 58 targets through the first nine games of the year, mainly with Kirk Cousins under center. He'll try to establish that kind of rapport with Mendoza in Week 11 against a Broncos secondary that ranks sixth i

George Kittle continues to be one of the NFL's most consistent tight ends ahead of the 49ers' Week 11 clash with Minnesota. Kittle tallied six catches for 74 yards this past Sunday in a win over Dallas, marking his eighth straight contest with at least four receptions. He's also registered at least 58 yards seven times during that span, giving him a very reliable weekly floor. Kittle could find the sledding tough against Minnesota, though, as the Vikings have given up the fewest fantasy points per game (5.1) to wideouts this season.

Parker Washington capitalized on a favorable Week 10 matchup against the Titans, dissecting Tennessee's league-worst secondary for seven catches, a season-high 152 receiving yards, and a touchdown. Heading into a Week 11 road game against the Giants, Washington leads the Jaguars in all major receiving categories with a 36-645-6 line on 64 targets. He has had some down games with Trevor Lawrence spreading the ball around, as Washington has finished with a single catch on two occasions this season. That lower floor, compared to some of the elite wideouts around the NFL, makes Washington more of

Rashee Rice's role and volume did not change much in Week 10 against the Falcons, even with trade deadline acquisition Josh Downs in the lineup for Kansas City. Rice caught five of six targets for 82 yards, the third time in seven games he's recorded at least 80 receiving yards. The fourth-year wide receiver is the top downfield option for Patrick Mahomes, but his 30-374-2 line on 38 targets is far from elite production. Rice will look to take a step forward in Week 11 against a Cardinals secondary that ranks 17th in fantasy points per game allowed to WRs.

news.text: Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.. Rice led the Chiefs in receiving yards and finished second in receptions and targets on a prolific afternoon for the Chiefs' air attack. Rice didn't get in on the scoring fun of a five-touchdown day for Patrick Mahomes, but he still eclipsed 80 receiving yards for the third time this season and first time since Week 3. Rice's level of involvement was encouraging given the debuting Josh Downs drew five targets, keeping the former's prospects bright for a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

players.outlook: George Pickens snagged three touchdowns last game for the Cowboys. Pickens racked up an incredible 18 targets, parlaying those looks into 11 grabs for 145 yards and the three scores. The targets and receptions set career highs, while the yardage total was his best on the season. In Week 11, Pickens has a delectable matchup against the Titans. Tennessee is allowing 266.9 passing yards per tilt, which is dead last in the NFL.

Patrick Mahomes is coming off a huge performance in a Week 10 win over the Falcons, as he threw five touchdown passes for the first time since Week 1 of the 2022 season. The trade-deadline addition of Josh Downs revitalized the passing game, as four different Kansas City players had receptions of 30-plus yards. Mahomes has a 10:0 TD:INT ratio over the last three games with two 300-yard performances, giving him significant momentum heading into a Week 11 clash with a Cardinals defense that ranks 29th in fantasy points per game allowed to QBs.

Ollie Gordon will have a heavy workload for as long as the Dolphins remain competitive in Week 11 against the Bills. Gordon has at least 16 carries in five straight games and caught a season-high four passes in Week 10, though Miami was in a four-quarter game against the Colts. Buffalo figures to be a far more difficult opponent, which could force a heavier pass-game script. With Buffalo allowing just 3.8 yards per carry, Gordon could be touchdown-dependent for top-end fantasy scoring.

Kaelon Black could be a key factor for San Francisco in Week 11 versus a tough Minnesota defense. The rookie running back has shown plenty of promise, and he's coming off a performance against the Cowboys during which he accounted for 66 total yards and a touchdown. Despite continuing to work behind superstar Christian McCaffrey, Black has recorded double-digit carries and at least 53 rushing yards in each of his past three games and has scored two touchdowns during that span. He's averaging a healthy 4.5 yards per carry on the season, which could give him plenty of importance against a Minnes

T.J. Hockenson will aim to make a return as the Vikings play the 49ers in Week 11. Hockenson missed his first game of the year in Week 10 against the Packers due to a wrist and chest injury. The veteran was unable to participate in practice prior to the matchup, so he'll likely need to get out there if he hopes to play in Mexico City. San Francisco has ranked middle-of-the-pack in fantasy points allowed to tight ends this season.

news.text: Hockenson (wrist) practiced on a limited basis Thursday.. After sitting out this past Sunday's win at Green Bay due to wrist and chest injuries, Hockenson has logged back-to-back capped sessions to begin Week 11 prep due to just the wrist issue. He'll have one more opportunity to get back to full Friday, at which point the Vikings may tag him with a designation ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.

players.outlook: Jaylen Waddle sustained a concussion in the Broncos' final game before their bye, winding up with just a 22-yard reception on his only target. The former Dolphin has struggled to adjust to his new offense, and through nine games this season he's produced a 30-337-2 line on 52 targets, putting him on pace for a career low in receiving yards. Assuming he clears the concussion protocol in time to suit up in Week 11, he'll be facing a Raiders secondary that ranks 24th in fantasy points per game allowed to WRs.

news.text: Waddle (concussion) was a full practice participant Thursday.. A full practice participant for the second day in a row, Waddle looks to be close to clearing the NFL's concussion protocol after he sustained the head injury in a Nov. 8 win over the Panthers. Assuming he can receive clearance from an independent neurologist by the weekend, Waddle will be removed from the protocol and suit up Sunday versus the Raiders.

players.outlook: Trevor Lawrence has thrown at least three touchdown passes in three of his last four starts and topped 300 passing yards in three of his last five, firmly placing him in the fantasy QB1 range for a Week 11 road game against the Giants. The 7-2 Jaguars and 5-3-1 Giants both lead their respective divisions, but Jacksonville's plus-125 point differential is far more impressive than the Giants' plus-7 mark. Pass defense has been a strength for the Giants, as they allow the third-fewest yards per game through the air (184). However, Lawrence maintains an elite ceiling regardless of opponent and cou

news.text: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.. It was another huge performance from the 27-year-old QB, as Lawrence set a new season high in passing yards and threw at least three TDs for the fifth time in nine games to begin the year. He spread the ball around again, as seven different Jaguars caught multiple passes and Parker Washington, Josh Cameron and Brenton Strange were all on the other end of scores. Lawrence will take a sharp 21:5 TD:INT into a Week 11 clash with the Giants.

players.outlook: No team has as soft a schedule on the defensive side of things than do the Ravens; only the Cowboys (Week 3), Bengals (7 and 17) and Bills (8) stand out as particularly challenging matchups. That's a good thing, considering this unit finished a disappointing 21st in scoring last season. The Ravens still have stars on the defensive side, and the change in head coach to Jesse Minter and defensive coordinator to Anthony Weaver should fuel a rebound to some degree.

Geno Smith will need to overcome an ankle injury if he's to help the Jets take down the Chargers in Week 11. Smith was in and out of the lineup in Week 10, his first time ceding snaps under center all season, resulting in his second straight game without a touchdown pass. Smith now has one or zero scores in seven of his 10 outings. While the Chargers have allowed at least 340 passing yards in consecutive games, they've also surrendered multiple touchdown passes just three times in nine games, not setting Smith up for high-end production in Week 11. news.text: Smith (ankle) will practice Friday, and head coach Aaron Glenn said "things look promising for him playing Sunday," Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.. While the initial report indicated only that Smith would practice, Eric Allen of the Jets' official website reported that Smith will be a full participant Friday, which makes it even more likely that he will be under center in Week 11. The Jets' final injury report will reveal whether or not Smith carries an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chargers.

players.outlook: Carnell Tate hasn't played since Week 7 due to a shoulder injury. Prior to his absence, the rookie fourth overall pick had at least 69 receiving yards in three of his last four appearances. If Tate gets the green light to play in Week 11, he would be a high-end flex option against a Dallas defense that's allowing 158 yards and a TD per game through the air to wide receivers. Titans QB Cam Ward is coming off his two best outings of the season in Tate's absence.

news.text: Tate (shoulder) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.. Tate appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Dallas after he's missed the last two games against Cincinnati and Jacksonville. The Titans could definitely use the rookie wideout after Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on season-ending injured reserve earlier this week. Tate's return would likely push Chimere Dike back into WR4 duties, with Xavier Restrepo the more sensible slot replacement for Robinson.

players.outlook: Kyle Pitts will look to rebound from a poor performance in Atlanta's Week 10 matchup against the Chiefs. After catching 15 of 18 targets for 122 yards and four touchdowns from Weeks 5 through 7, Pitts has really struggled. In his last two games, the Florida product has hauled in just five of 10 targets for 29 yards and no scores, making him too inconsistent to be a week-in and week-out starter going forward. However, he's in for a favorable Week 10 matchup against a Kansas City defense that's allowed 17.0 fantasy points per game to opposing tight ends this season.

Darren Waller is expected to remain the Panthers' top receiving option at tight end during the Week 11 matchup against the Ravens. Despite Waller leading Carolina's tight end corps in receptions (25), targets (38) and receiving yards (323) through nine games this year, he's been super inconsistent as of late. The veteran has logged two-or-fewer receptions in four of his last five games, with the exception coming in the Week 9 loss to the Broncos, in which he caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown. news.text: Waller (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joseph Person of The Athletic reports.. According to Person, Waller told coach Dave Canales he's ready to play Sunday against Baltimore, so fantasy players should proceed as if Waller will be active. Waller's production has been all over the place this season, making him difficult to pin down as a reliable weekly fantasy option. He's more of a best-ball type of fantasy asset.

players.outlook: Adonai Mitchell continues to bring inefficiency through steady opportunity with the Jets set to face the Chargers in Week 11. Mitchell has 24 targets over the last three weeks but has converted them into just 10 catches, tallying a solid 201 yards. The Chargers' secondary is allowing the sixth-most fantasy points to wideouts, and Mitchell figures to see consistent volume, particularly with Omar Cooper (ankle) uncertain to play. But Geno Smith's ankle injury also brings ambiguity to this passing game, making Mitchell a high-upside, low-floor option.

David Montgomery (groin) remained sidelined for Houston's Week 10 loss against the Browns despite practicing without limitations the Friday preceding the game. He hasn't played since Week 5, but Montgomery has the green light to suit up against the Colts in Week 11 and is in line for a prominent role, as Woody Marks (concussion) will miss Thursday's game on a short week after getting hurt in Week 10. No other RB besides Montgomery or Marks has more than 13 carries for the Texans this season. Despite averaging just 2.7 yards per carry prior to his injury, Montgomery has RB2 upside given the lac

news.text: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.. Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov

players.outlook: Jadarian Price looks to be settling in as Seattle's No. 2 RB ahead of a Week 10 clash against Las Vegas. The rookie running back handled 13 touches this past Sunday in a win over Arizona while Zach Charbonnet logged 17 touches. However, Charbonnet had 16 carries to Prize's nine, suggesting that the former may be leaning more toward a change-of-pace role. Both Charbonnet and Price could be utilized heavily against the Raiders, who have given up the second-most fantasy points per game (23.1) to running backs this season.

In Week 10, Quinshon Judkins and the Browns return home for the first time in three weeks to host the Texans. He rushed 15 times for 43 yards and caught his only target for two yards during Cleveland's overtime loss in Week 9. Judkins and the entire Browns offense struggled to make much happen on the ground, registering 95 yards on 34 carries for a meager 2.8 yards per attempt. Judkins has been underwhelming in 2026, racking up 385 yards on 116 carries (3.3 YPC) with three TDs and a 22-136-0 receiving line on 25 targets. He'll try to turn things around versus a Houston defense allowing 22.4 fa

Chubba Hubbard will continue operating as the Panthers' bell-cow back in the Week 11 matchup against the Ravens. Hubbard put Carolina on his back during the Week 10 win over the Saints, accumulating 172 yards and two touchdowns on 32 touches. On the season, Hubbard ranks fifth in the NFL in touches per game (21.3) eighth in scrimmage yards per game (106.4), suggesting he'll remain one of fantasy's top running backs as the year progresses. Despite this, he could struggle against a good Ravens defense that's allowed just 19.9 fantasy points per game to opposing running backs through nine games t

The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. players.outlook: Tanner McKee continues to struggle under center for the Eagles, though admittedly he is working with limited help. Though running back Saquon Barkley returned from injury in the loss to Washington, staring wideouts Devonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks remained sidelined, and the right side of the offensive line is still a work in progress. McKee had two turnovers while failing to throw a touchdown against the Commanders. In Week 9, McKee will face a much-improved Giants pass defense. Audric Estime is expected to remain New Orleans' top short-yardage back in the Week 11 matchup against the Bears. Estime was inefficient in the Week 10 loss to the Panthers, rushing seven times for six yards. It's a positive sign for Estime's fantasy outlook going forward that he still had a valuable role in New Orleans' offense, despite the return of lead-back Travis Etienne. However, Estime will likely have minimal fantasy value without finding the end zone. He's set to face a solid Bears defense that's given up just five rushing touchdowns to RBs this year.

Kyler Murray will look to get healthy in Week 11 as the Vikings play San Francisco. Murray hasn't seen the field since a Week 8 loss to Detroit, and the Vikings' trade for Kirk Cousins has essentially erased his value at this point in the season. If healthy, he'll aim to take away the current backup role from veteran Carson Wentz.

news.text: Murray (hamstring) will miss Wednesday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.. The Vikings are targeting a Week 12 matchup with the Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 29, for Murray to be available again, so his lack of activity this week doesn't come as a susprise. Whenever Murray is back, though, he likely will take on No. 2 QB duties due to the arrival of Kirk Cousins from Las Vegas at the trade deadline.

players.outlook: Malik Willis is headed for the IR after an MRI revealed a core-muscle injury. The diagnosis will sideline him through at least Week 13. Kyle McCord is poised to take over under center.

news.text: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.. Per Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald, Hafley noted on that subject Monday, "We will see how he feels. If he needs surgery, he will have surgery," while adding that if the QB does undergo a procedure, it wouldn't "necessarily" be season ending. In any case, the earliest Willis can come off IR is Week 14, with Kyle McCord and Brady Cook currently available to handle Miami's signal-caller duties.

players.outlook: Kenny Gainwell is expected to remain Tampa Bay's No. 2 running back in the Week 11 matchup against the Lions. Despite Gainwell playing behind Bucky Irving, he's tallied 304 yards from scrimmage over the Buccaneers' last three games. Additionally, head coach Todd Bowles told reporters Monday that the team will aim to lessen Irving's workload going forward, suggesting Gainwell's role on the offense could expand as the year progresses. However, Gainwell may struggle against the Lions in Week 11, as the Detroit has allowed just 3.7 yards per carry to opposing running backs this year.

Jaxson Dart was electric in Week 1 for the New York Giants. Dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns, while also rushing for an additional 54 yards in the stunning 28-20 win over the Cowboys. Dart threw just five incompletions and showed excellent rapport with new tight end Isaiah Likely. Dart was accurate, decisive and poised in what amounted to an extremely promising start to the season for the G-Men. In Week 2, the Giants will face a Los Angeles Rams defense that was surprisingly poor in their opener, allowing 379 scrimmage yards, which ranks them in the bottom third of the NFL. The Ra

news.text: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.. Dart's ACL and PCL were apparently spared, but the quarterback remains done for the 2026 regular season after he was injured in the first quarter of Week 2 against the Rams. It's unclear if Dart could make a postseason return if the Giants are able to make it that far. Jameis Winston and newly acquired J.J. McCarthy will handle quarterback duties moving forward this season.

players.outlook: Bryce Young is expected to continue leading the Panthers' offense during the Week 11 matchup against the Ravens. Young had a relatively underwhelming performance in the Week 10 win over the Saints, completing 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception. Despite this outing, Young ranks sixth in the NFL in pass attempts (37.6) and yards (266.3) per game, suggesting a positive fantasy outlook moving forward. However, Young could struggle against a solid Ravens defense that's given up just 20.4 fantasy points per game to opposing quarterbacks through nine games this year.

Baker Mayfield (foot/ankle) is expected to lead the Buccaneers' offense if active for the Week 11 matchup against the Lions. Mayfield sustained an injury to his foot and ankle area during the Week 9 loss to the Bears, putting his availability for Sunday's contest in jeopardy. Since returning from a thumb injury in the Week 7 win over the Panthers, Mayfield has completed 25 of 46 pass attempts for 307 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions, suggesting his fantasy outlook is bleak going forward. However, he could find success against a Lions defense that's struggled this season, allowing the

news.text: Mayfield (foot) is trending in the right direction to start Sunday's game against the Lions after looking good in Friday's practice, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.. With Mayfield back on the field again Friday after earlier managing the foot issue this week, Tampa Bay appears to be gaining optimism about its starting quarterback's availability for Sunday against the Lions. His official game designation for Sunday still will be key, but coach Todd Bowles' comments point toward Mayfield having a chance to avoid another absence.

players.outlook: Jacory Croskey-Merritt rushed for a season-high 82 yards last game for the Commanders. Bill also found the end zone for the second time this season. Croskey-Merritt has seen double-digit touches in every contest thus far in 2026. In Week 6, Washington will face the San Francisco 49ers. The Niners are allowing 97.6 rushing yards per tilt, which is 10th in the NFL. San Francisco has also given up just three rushing touchdowns through five outings, which is tied for sixth in the league.

news.text: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.. The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt for return from injured reserve Tuesday, and in the team's first official practice of Week 11 prep, he was uninhibited. Assuming he's able to maintain that activity level Friday and Saturday, he's a good bet to miss the minimum four games on IR due to the groin injury that bothered him multiple weeks through the first five contests of the campaign.

players.outlook: MarShawn Lloyd will aim to shed an injury tag as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Lloyd was inactive in Week 9 against the Patriots with a knee injury, which paved the way for Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong to lead Green Bay's rushing attack after Josh Jacobs exited with a finger ailment. If Lloyd is active against Minnesota, he could very well lead the backfield versus a defense that's ranked top 10 in fantasy points allowed to RBs.

In Week 11, Jacoby Brissett and the Ravens travel to face the Panthers in an interconference matchup. He completed 33 of 49 pass attempts for 340 yards with no TDs and one INT while rushing twice for two yards during his Baltimore debut in Week 10. Brissett connected with seven different receivers and led the Ravens to a final score above 13 points for the first time since Week 5. However, the team did lose its fifth game in a row, so Brissett will look to get into the win column versus a Carolina defense allowing 19.9 fantasy points per game (10th) to opposing QBs.

RJ Harvey logged just five touches in the Broncos' Week 7 win over the Cardinals, but he turned one of them into a 52-yard TD reception in the third quarter to salvage his day. The second-year back finished third in the backfield in workload behind rookie Jonah Coleman (11 touches) and veteran J.K. Dobbins (six touches), but Harvey seems to have a steady role as a passing-down option for Bo Nix. Even if Sean Payton continues to roll with a committee approach to his ground game, Harvey's floor should be relatively secure, even if his ceiling is limited to occasional big plays. news.text: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.. Harvey was already ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Chiefs, but now that he's on IR, the second-year running back will be required to miss at least the next four games. That means the earliest that he is eligible to return is Week 13 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Dec. 6. In Harvey's absence, the Broncos' backfield will be led by J.K. Dobbins and rookie fourth-rounder Jonah Coleman.

players.outlook: Jared Goff will aim to take some momentum into Week 11 as the Lions play the Buccaneers. Goff broke a two-game stretch of struggles in a Week 10 win over the Patriots, completing 65 percent of passes for 303 yards with a 3:2 TD:INT. The veteran has now dished out 18 touchdowns with 2,437 passing yards across nine games this campaign. He'll face a Tampa Bay defense that's ranked top five in fantasy points allowed to QBs.

Michael Penix will lead the Falcons' offense into the Week 10 matchup against the Chiefs. Penix has underwhelmed over Atlanta's last two games, completing just 28 of 55 pass attempts for 287 yards, one touchdown and five interceptions. This is especially disappointing considering Penix's terrific start to the year, in which he averaged 231.4 passing yards and 1.8 passing touchdowns per game, while turning the ball over just twice over his first five appearances. Penix's struggles will likely continue in Week 10, as he's set to face a Kansas City defense that's given up just 16.1 fantasy points
De'Von Achane will miss the remainder of the season after tearing his ACL. Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright will handle the bulk of the Dolphins' carries.

news.text: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.. Achane's move to injured reserve was merely a formality after head coach Jeff Hafley confirmed earlier Monday that the running back would be lost for the season after sustaining an ACL tear in his left knee during Sunday's 24-10 loss to Kansas City. With Achane out of the mix for the rest of 2026, the Dolphins are left with Jaylen Wright (foot) and Ollie Gordon as the lone running backs on the 53-man roster.

players.outlook: Deshaun Watson and the Browns welcome his former team to town when they host the Texans in Week 10. He was inactive for Cleveland's 23-22 overtime loss in Week 9 due to a concussion sustained in Week 8's loss. Shedeur Sanders earned his first start of the season, but Watson is healthy and expected to retain his role as the starting QB versus Houston. He'll battle a Texans defense allowing 21.8 fantasy points per game (25th) to the position.

Sam Darnold is slated to miss Seattle's Week 10 matchup against Las Vegas due to a quadriceps injury. Drew Lock is dealing with an oblique issue but is expected to be able to start at quarterback for a second straight week.

news.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.. Darnold, who last played in Week 8, still is working his way through a pair of injuries, but barring any setbacks, he's trending toward a Week 12 return. Macdonald reiterated that Darnold will be the team's starter once healthy, even though backup Drew Lock has guided Seattle to a 4-0 record while coming on in relief or starting in place of an injured Darnold in the first two games of the season as w

players.outlook: Justice Hill and the Ravens are back on the road for an interconference clash against the Panthers in Week 11. He had three carries for four yards and caught five of seven targets for 34 yards during Baltimore's Week 10 defeat. Hill set new season highs in receptions and yardage with Jacoby Brissett making his team debut, a trend that could continue. Hill will try to exploit a Carolina defense allowing 27.3 fantasy points per game (29th) to opposing RBs.

Tyler Shough is set to lead the Saints' offense into the Week 11 matchup against the Bears. Shough had an underwhelming outing in the Week 10 loss to the Panthers, completing 25 of 35 pass attempts for 187 yards, one touchdown and one interception. Despite this, he remains tied for the second-most pass attempts per game (38.1) in the NFL this season, suggesting he'll have loads of opportunities for points as the year progresses. Shough is set to face a Bears defense that's given up just 20.8 fantasy points per game to opposing quarterbacks this season.

J.J. McCarthy has thrown for at least 240 yards in three of the last four games for the Giants. McCarthy completed 23-of-36 passes for 293 yards, one touchdown and one interception last game versus the Commanders. The interception also came on a last-minute heave as the Giants attempted a comeback. In Week 11, the Giants will face a Jacksonville defense that has been mediocre against the pass in 2026. The Jags are allowing 228.2 passing yards per tilt, which is 19th in the NFL. However, Jacksonville has surrendered just 10 passing scores this season, which is fourth in the NFL.

Jameis Winston was benched in favor of J.J. McCarthy last game for the Giants. McCarthy led a furious comeback attempt, throwing for an astonishing 243 yards in the fourth quarter alone in relief of Winston. While the G-Men ultimately lost to the Saints by a score of 34-27, McCarthy's near-heroics have likely created a quarterback controversy heading into Week 7 versus the Texans. Whomever lines up under center may have a favorable matchup, as Houston is allowing 246 passing yards per tilt, which is 27th in the league.

After a miserable 2025 that saw them surrender the most yards while scoring the third-fewest fantasy points, the Commanders brought in a slew of offseason reinforcements, though it was more of a quantitative than qualitative process. There's no reason to trust this D/ST in Weeks 1 and 2, which are road matchups with the Eagles and Cowboys, but if the Commanders show midseason promise, bear in mind its most favorable matchups come during the season's second half.

Drew Lock  is expected to start for Seattle in Week 10 against Las Vegas despite managing an oblique injury. It will be the second straight start for Lock, as Sam Darnold is slated to sit out again due to a quad injury. Lock led the Seahawks to a win this past Sunday against the Cardinals but put up modest numbers, throwing for 175 yards and one touchdown with no interceptions. He'll have a good matchup against the Raiders, who have allowed a 103.6 QB rating to passers this season, fourth-worst in the NFL.

In Week 11, Rico Dowdle and the Steelers visit the Eagles for an interconference tilt. He rushed five times for 26 yards and caught both targets for eight yards during Pittsburgh's 38-18 loss in Week 10. Dowdle and Jaylen Warren (7 carries, 15 yards) both struggled to make much of an impact, as the Steelers managed just 247 total yards of offense on the night. Dowdle could be more involved against an Eagles squad that has lost seven in a row, but Philadelphia's defense is allowing the seventh-fewest fantasy points per game to opposing RBs (19.7) in the league.

Kyle McCord could have a busy outing if the Dolphins fall behind the Bills in Week 11. He made his first start of the season in Week 10 with Malik Willis landing on injured reserve, and threw 32 times, completing 17 to nine different teammates. Buffalo is allowing just 6.8 yards per attempt, but the game script should favor heavy volume for McCord, giving him a chance to be a low-end starting option.

Jalon Daniels will operate as the Buccaneers' signal-caller if Baker Mayfield (foot/ankle) is sidelined for the Week 11 matchup against the Lions. Daniels made three starts while Mayfield was sidelined with a thumb injury from Weeks 4 through 6, accounting for 618 yards, three touchdowns and four interceptions. If starting in Week 11, Daniels could take advantage of a Lions defense that's allowed 183 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns to quarterbacks this season. Additionally, Detroit has allowed the most fantasy points per game to opposing quarterbacks (25.0) in the NFL through 10 weeks

Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers visit the Eagles for an interconference clash in Week 11. In Pittsburgh's Week 10 loss, he completed 15 of 29 pass attempts for 143 yards with two TDs and no INTs while rushing twice for minus-one yard. Rodgers and the entire Steelers offense struggled against the Bengals, which was not a very encouraging sign coming off a bye week. He'll try to bounce back versus a Philadelphia team allowing 21.4 fantasy points per game to opposing QBs.

Isiah Pacheco will be out again in Week 11 as the Lions play the Buccaneers. Pacheco was placed on IR to start the season due to a back injury, and he underwent surgery in mid-September. This puts the former Kansas City RB's return this season in jeopardy. He's expected to be back sometime in December, so Sione Vaki will continue to handle RB2 duties behind Jahmyr Gibbs.

news.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.. Pacheco has been sidelined for the entirety of the regular season to this point after undergoing back surgery in September. Sione Vaki has been working as the Lions' clear RB2, though Jahmyr Gibbs has been a true workhorse out of the backfield. If Pacheco does return at the end of the regular season, it's hard to envision him having a big impact coming off back surgery.

players.outlook: Sanders enters his second NFL season set to back up Deshaun Watson in Cleveland. Sanders made eight appearances during his rookie season and wasn't overly productive, scoring eight all-purpose touchdowns, throwing 10 interceptions and completing 57% of his passes. The fifth-round pick produced one weekly fantasy finish better than 18th, though it was an impressive 364-yard passing game with four total touchdowns (33.5 points). Sanders added some value with his legs, including 20-plus yards in five straight games to end the season. The 24-year-old remains a wild card and is likely to earn some

Joe Milton's first NFL start for the Eagles resulted in a loss, but there were promising signs. Milton did not throw an interception, and he also flashed his dual-threat ability with 64 yards versus the Giants. However, Milton completed only 52.9-percent of his throws for just 169 yards. He could get both DeVonta Smith as well as Dontayvion Wicks back from injury in Week 11 versus the Steelers, which would bolster an extremely depleted wide receiving corps. Tyler Allgeier and the Cardinals will face a tough Kansas City defense in Week 11. Allgeier struggled in this past Sunday's loss to the Rams, gaining only 14 yards on five carries and failing to catch his only target. What's more, he logged just a 44 percent offensive snap share despite the absence of Jeremiyah Love (ankle), who's slated to miss several more weeks. Allgeier may be splitting backfield work with Bam Knight against a sturdy KC run defense that is yielding the second-fewest yards per carry (3.46) to running backs this season.

Carson Beck will look for better results in his second NFL start when Arizona faces Kansas City in Week 11. Beck threw for just 108 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions this past Sunday in his NFL debut (a loss to the Rams). The rookie has been pressed into action as the Cardinals' starting quarterback following the loss of Gardner Minshew to a season-ending elbow injury. Beck may have a tough time in his second start, as Kansas City has given up the fourth-lowest QB rating (77.4) this season.

Justin Herbert didn't need to do much with his arm in the Chargers' first win of the season, a Week 10 victory on Monday night over the Ravens. The quarterback threw for just 129 yards and failed to toss a touchdown for the third time in the last four games, but he did run in his first TD of the year. Herbert was missing top wide receiver Ladd McConkey once again, but the offense has been mostly ineffective even when McConkey has been healthy. Herbert will try to build on this performance in Week 11 against a Jets defense that ranks 19th in fantasy points per game allowed to QBs.

Will Reichard will seek to stay hot as the Vikings play the 49ers in Week 11. Reichard was perfect in a Week 10 win over Green Bay, nailing all six of his kicks with three field-goal makes. The third-year kicker has now converted 23 of 25 field-goal attempts and made all 13 of his XPAs across nine showings. The 49ers have allowed a middle-of-the-pack 8.0 points per game to kickers this season.

Cam Ward has taken a noticeable step forward in Tennessee's last two games, even though the Titans lost both to drop to 1-8. After throwing for a career-high 304 yards and tossing multiple touchdown passes for the first time this season against the Bengals, Ward threw for 231 yards and two TDs in the Week 10 loss to Jacksonville, his second-highest passing yards total of the campaign. His four touchdown passes in that two-game stretch match Ward's total from his first seven starts of the season. The improving 2025 first overall pick has a nice opportunity to keep building momentum in Week 11 a

Matthew Stafford will have to operate without his favorite target in the Rams' Week 10 tilt against Arizona. Puka Nacua, who Stafford has targeted at least 10 times in five of his past six games, has a knee injury that is expected to require a stint on IR. The Rams are also still without Davante Adams (hamstring - IR), so Stafford will have to look to other wideouts, as well as the tight-end corps, more often moving forward. He'll at least have a promising matchup in Week 10, as the Cardinals have allowed the third-most fantasy points (23.9) to quarterbacks this season.

TreVeyon Henderson is uncertain to face the Lions in Week 10 due to an ongoing illness when the Patriots travel to Munich. Henderson has not played since Week 7, and New England has a bye week following their travels, which will allow Henderson additional time to recover. With Rhamondre Stevenson dealing with a knee injury, Corey Kiner could lead this backfield against a defense that is allowing the third-fewest fantasy points to opposing rushers.

news.text: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.. Henderson was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich, and now that he's on IR, the second-year running back will be required to miss at least the next four games. Henderson's next opportunity to play is Week 15 against the Chiefs on Monday, Dec. 21, although there's no timetable for his return, as he is recovering from "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of neurological symptoms." If Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) cannot play Sunday, then the Patriots' backfield will be led by Corey Kiner and Lan Larison.

players.outlook: In Week 10, KC Concepcion and the Browns are home for the first time since Week 6 to host the Texans. He grabbed four of six targets for 85 yards, including a 64-yard touchdown, during Cleveland's 23-22 overtime loss in Week 9. The score was the rookie wideout's first of his young career, and he now sports a 37-437-1 receiving line on 55 targets to go along with 10 carries for 37 yards through nine games. Concepcion will aim to take advantage of a Houston defense allowing the third-most fantasy points per game (38.5) to opposing WRs.

Fernando Mendoza did the best he could in his first NFL start against an extremely tough opponent, as the Raiders lost to the Seahawks in Week 10. The rookie quarterback completed under 60% of his passes and didn't throw for a touchdown, but he also avoided committing a turnover and ran in a 10-yard score for Las Vegas' only TD. Mendoza could face another obstacle, as star tight end Brock Bowers suffered an ankle injury that might sideline him for a spell and leave the offense without any game-plan targets. Mendoza will do his best with what he has to work with in Week 11 against a Broncos def

Jalen Hurts struggled again last game for the Eagles. Hurts completed just 21-of-40 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown in the ugly 19-17 loss to the Jaguars. Hurts has yet to throw for 300 yards in a game this season. He also had by far his worst rushing output of the 2026 campaign with only two yards on the ground, perhaps due to a nagging calf issue. In Week 6, Philadelphia will face a curious Carolina Panthers pass defense. Carolina is allowing 230.8 passing yards per tilt, which is 22nd in the NFL. However, the Panthers have yielded just five passing touchdowns, which is tied for fourth

news.text: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.. Initially diagnosed with a superficial blood clot after being cleated in the left calf in an Oct. 4 loss to the Rams, Hurts had been cleared by doctors to play in Week 5 in the Eagles' loss to the Jaguars in London before more recent testing last week showed that the blood clot had moved. According to a statement released Monday by his agent, Nicole Lynn, Hurts now has been diagnosed with a deep vein thrombosis in the left calf, as well as bilateral pulmonary emboli.

players.outlook: Alec Pierce aggravated a left heel injury in Week 2, stemming from his offseason left ankle surgery. The Colts' leading receiver from last season probably faces a multi-week absence and won't play against the Texans in Week 3. Josh Downs and Keenan Allen are set to lead Indianapolis' underwhelming WR room versus Houston.

news.text: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.. "We'll see. Like I said last week, he's still in that rehab process, and I'm not going to put a timetable on return," Steichen noted of the wideout, who's been on IR since Sept. 26. At 2-7, the Colts were sellers ahead of the NFL's trade deadline, so the team presumably has no reason rush Pierce back. With Keenan Allen and Josh Downs no longer in the mix, Indy's healthy WRs for now are Ashton Dulin, Laquon Treadwell, Anthony Gould, Deion Burks and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.

players.outlook: Tyjae Spears turned five touches into 28 yards in the Titans' Week 10 loss to Jacksonville in his first action since Week 6. The change-of-pace RB has dealt with ankle and knee injuries this season. The surging Tony Pollard is locked in as the top option in Tennessee's backfield, but Spears may be able to do enough with his handful of touches to warrant deep-league flex consideration for Week 11 against the Cowboys, who have been the most generous defense in the league to RBs. Dallas has allowed 16 TDs to the position through 10 games, as well as 155 scrimmage yards per game.

news.text: Spears (knee) was limited in practice Thursday.. The running back returned to action last Sunday against the Jaguars and logged 16 snaps behind Tony Pollard's 41. Spears is only playable in Week 11 against Dallas as a desperation fantasy option.

players.outlook: George Holani and the Seahawks host the Chiefs on Sunday Night Football in Week 7. He rushed five times for 20 yards and a touchdown during Seattle's 17-14 loss in overtime in Week 6. Holani made the most of his touches by scoring his first rushing TD of the season, but he's expected to have his opportunities reduced with the likely return of Zach Charbonnet (knee) off the reserve/PUP list. It would be wise to steer clear of the Seahawks backfield against a Kansas City defense allowing 19.0 fantasy points allowed per game to RBs, which is tied for ninth.

Germie Bernard and the Steelers are in Philadelphia for a Week 11 interconference clash. He failed to bring in any of his three targets during Week 10's loss to Cincinnati but did gain 10 yards on his lone carry. Bernard was held without a catch for the first time since Week 1, when he played only three offensive snaps. Pittsburgh's offense struggled all night, gaining just 247 total yards, but the hope is that Bernard will bounce back versus an Eagles defense allowing 37.9 fantasy points per game to opposing WRs.

Bam Knight appears set to work in a backfield timeshare with Tyler Allgeier for the Cardinals in Week 11 against Kansas City. Knight returned from a one-game absence to face the Rams this past Sunday, and he logged a 56 percent offensive snap share to Allgeier's 44 percent. However, Knight didn't do much with the opportunity, gaining just 19 yards on five carries and going without a catch on two targets. Both running backs could find the sledding tough against a Kansas City defense that ranks seventh in the NFL with 15.2 fantasy points per game allowed to running backs.

Elijah Mitchell led the Eagles in rushing last game. Jaydon Blue was initially thought to be the primary backup to Saquon Barkley, but it was Mitchell who led the Eagles with 34 yards on the ground. In fact, Blue did not even register a carry in the 27-10 loss to the Commanders. Barkley has been assured he will not be traded, leaving Blue as an afterthought, and perhaps even behind Mitchell on the depth chart. Meanwhile, a potentially juicy matchup is on the horizon in Week 9 versus the Giants for whomever is the bell cow. New York is allowing 128.1 rushing yards per tilt, which is 26th in the

Tank Bigsby replaced an injured Saquon Barkley last game for the Eagles, only to suffer an injury of his own late in the contest. Bigsby rushed 14 times for 55 yards to lead the Eagles before exiting with a lower-body issue. His status is up in the air for Week 5 versus the Jags. If neither Bigsby nor Barkley can play, Will Shipley would be in line for an expanded role. However, Jacksonville has played the run extremely well thus far in 2026. The Jags are allowing just 74.3 rushing yards per tote, which us second in the NFL.

news.text: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.. Bigsby will undergo core muscle surgery for an abdominal injury that he picked up during the Eagles' Week 4 loss to the Rams. The fourth-year pro will be required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 9 against the Giants. Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is also considered week-to-week, so with Bigsby on IR, Will Shipley could be the Eagles' starting running back for Week 5 against the Jaguars on Sunday in London.

players.outlook: Jordan Addison is set to remain out as the Vikings play the 49ers in Week 11. Addison missed a Week 10 win over Green Bay with a thumb injury, and he's likely to require a possible IR-designating surgery. Jauan Jennings (calf), Myles Price and Tai Felton could all see an uptick in usage with Addison inactive.

news.text: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.. Thus, the Vikings are expecting Addison to recover fully before the four games required of an IR stint, but in any case he will miss some time due to the thumb injury he suffered in practice last Friday and sidelined him this past Sunday at Green Bay. With Addison out of the lineup, Minnesota will be relying on Justin Jefferson, Jauan Jennings (calf), Myles Price, Tai Felton and Jeshaun Jones at wide receiver.

players.outlook: Jaleel McLaughlin and the Browns are in Tennessee for an interconference tilt in Week 7. He rushed nine times for 41 yards and caught all four targets for another 14 yards during Cleveland's Week 6 win. With Quinshon Judkins (ankle) inactive, McLaughlin and Audric Estime each tallied nine carries to lead the backfield. McLaughlin paced the team in yardage and tied for the lead in receptions. If Judkins can't play against the Titans' 13th-ranked defense in fantasy points allowed per game (20.3) to RBs, McLaughlin could find himself busy again.

Makai Lemon has been the top target for the Eagles of late due to several injuries, though that could change following the bye. Lemon has at least eight targets in three-straight contests, but DeVonta Smith and/or Dontayvion Wicks could return from the shelf in Week 11 versus the Steelers. While Lemon should still remain involved, his opportunities could decrease despite the favorable matchup with the Steelers. Pittsburgh is allowing 242.2 passing yards per tilt, which is 30th in the NFL.

James is an intriguing insurance stash as a candidate to work as 30-year-old Christian McCaffrey's backup in San Francisco. The 2025 fifth-round pick didn't record a single touch on three snaps during a rookie campaign spent buried behind McCaffrey and a host of veterans. James wasn't utilized much as a receiver at the collegiate level and underwhelmed at last year's combine, so it's unclear what his upside will be in the pros. However, if the 22-year-old wins the No. 2 gig over rookie Kaelon Black and McCaffrey misses action, he'll be a priority add. Consider him in the final few rounds in de

Sione Vaki will aim to make the most of his touches as the Lions play the Buccaneers in Week 11. Vaki recorded six carries for 28 yards and tacked on a 17-yard catch in a Week 10 win over the Patriots. The RB2 is still far below Jahmyr Gibbs in the backfield totem pole, but he's been efficient when the ball's in his hands, especially in the last four weeks. Unfortunately, he'll face a Tampa Bay defense that's allowed the fewest fantasy points per game to RBs.

Austin Ekeler has received at least eight touches in three-straight games for the Commanders. He rushed nine times for 26 yards in the most recent win over the Giants, while also catching four passes for 26 yards out of the backfield. However, Jacory Croskey-Merritt may return from injury in Week 11 versus the Bengals, which would reduce Ekeler's workload behind Rachaad White.  If Croskey-Merritt cannot suit up, Ekeler would see more opportunities against a Cincy defense surrendering 123.9 rushing yards per clash, which is 21st in the league.

Chris Godwin is expected to operate as Tampa Bay's No. 2 wideout during the Week 11 matchup against the Lions. Coming off a Week 10 bye, Godwin ranks second on the Buccaneers in receiving yards (259), receptions (29) and targets (39). Despite being one of Tampa's top pass catchers, his fantasy production has been limited by the team's lack of a passing attack, which could continue in Week 11 as Baker Mayfield (foot/ankle) deals with an injury. However, Godwin could find success against a Detroit defense that's allowed 7.7 yards per target to opposing wideouts this year.

Chris Brooks will look to make a return as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Brooks has been on IR with an ankle injury and while his required four games out were fulfilled ahead of Week 9 against the Patriots, Green Bay decided to not activate him. The fourth-year ball carrier will likely need to log at least one full practice this week if he hopes to take on a Minnesota defense that's ranked top 10 against fantasy running backs.

Kaleb Johnson will aim to stay involved as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Johnson served as Green Bay's lead back after Josh Jacobs left in the first quarter of a Week 9 win over the Patriots. The former Steelers draft pick thrived in his role, rushing 14 times for 68 yards and a touchdown. Johnson's usage is very much contingent on the health of the RB room, especially with MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks both possibly returning soon. Either way, Minnesota has ranked top 10 against fantasy running backs this season, which could make it tough on whoever the Packers give the rock to o

Pierre Strong could see an elevated role as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Strong logged eight carries for 22 yards and two catches for 11 yards in a Week 9 win over the Patriots, with MarShawn Lloyd and Josh Jacobs both dealing with injuries. The fourth-year ball carrier has served a change-of-pace role in his five appearances this season, but he could see even bigger usage if his position mates are inactive. Minnesota has ranked top 10 in fantasy points allowed to RBs this campaign.

Dameon Pierce still managed to maintain a solid role despite the return of Saquon Barkley from injury for the Eagles.  Barkley rushed seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown but tweaked his hamstring while also suffering a compensatory back injury. This allowed Pierce to take 14 carries for 47 yards and a touchdown of his own.  However, Pierce could be seen leaving the field late in the fourth quarter with a potential injury as well. If neither Barkley nor Pierce can play in Week 8 versus Washington, Elijah Mitchell would be the only healthy option at running back. The Commanders are allowing

news.text: The Eagles released Pierce (undisclosed) from IR with an injury settlement Friday, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.. Pierce had been placed on injured reserve Oct. 28 due to an undisclosed issue. That was going to require him to miss at least four contests, but with the injury settlement, the veteran running back is now a free agent and is eligible to suit up as soon as he finds work with another club. Pierce appeared in three games with Philadelphia before being let go, rushing 37 times for 96 yards and two touchdowns while adding seven catches for 14 yards on 11 targets. He also took some turns as a kick returner, which could help him in his quest to latch on with another o

players.outlook: Emari Demercado could play a significant role for the Texans in Week 11 against the Colts. Woody Marks (concussion) won't play, while David Montgomery is suting up Thursday for his first action since Week 5. Demercado's appeal is limited to deep-league flex status in a change-of-pace role, though Montgomery may not be ready to take on a full workload against a Colts defense that's surrendering 151 scrimmage yards and a touchdown per game to RBs. Demercado averaged 6.5 yards per carry on 126 attempts spread across three years with the Cardinals, but that figure has plummeted to 2.6 yards per ca

Tyler Goodson is set to miss multiple weeks for the Cowboys due to a sprained knee. The timing is rough for Goodson, who is coming off his best performance of the season. Goodson rushed 12 times for 77 yards in the 27-23 win over the Colts. Either Israel Abanikanda or Jashaun Corbin will likely slide in as the backup running back, though neither is a reasonable option against a 49ers defense allowing just 80.9 rushing yards per game, which is second in the league.

Keaton Mitchell nearly disappeared from the Chargers' game plan in their first win of the season. During a Week 10 victory over the Ravens, he failed to catch his only target and eked out just four rushing yards on three carries, after handling 17 total touches in the prior two contests. Omarion Hampton, meanwhile, broke out for 105 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, potentially ending the team's backfield committee in decisive fashion. Mitchell will try to make a splash on what touches he gets in Week 11 against a Jets defense that's tied for 23rd in fantasy points per game allowed to RBs.

Najee Harris had five carries for just nine yards last game for the Giants. The running game as a whole was fairly contained, as starter Cam Skattebo rushed for just 58 yards in the 27-27 tie with Washington. Interestingly, Tyrone Tracy also had five touches in this contest, perhaps showing that the backup role remains up for grabs. In Week 6, the Giants will face a Saints defense that has been gutted on the ground thus far in 2026. New Orleans is allowing148.8 rushing yards per clash, which is 30th in the league. In addition, New Orleans has allowed the most rushing touchdowns in the league.

Isaiah Davis hasn't factored into the Jets' running plans despite Breece Hall's absence entering a Week 6 matchup with the Patriots. Davis has played a mere 11 offensive snaps in two games, rushing for eight yards on two carries while adding a nine-yard catch. Even if Hall doesn't return in Week 6, Davis would need further injury to Braelon Allen to collect enough touches to succeed against a run defense that's allowing 4.2 yards per carry.

Dylan Sampson and the Browns return home to face off against Houston in Week 10. He had eight carries for 21 yards and caught three of six targets for 27 yards during Cleveland's Week 9 overtime loss. Sampson finished tied for second on the team in targets, and with the Browns' offense likely to play from behind most weeks, he could provide a boost as the preferred back on passing downs. Sampson will aim to contribute more facing a Houston defense allowing 22.4 fantasy points per game (20th) to opposing RBs.

Jaylen Wright continues to be on the wrong side of rushing attempts as the Dolphins get set to face the Bills in Week 11. Wright hasn't logged more than six touches in any game this season and has reached 11 rushing yards just twice. With Buffalo allowing just 3.8 yards per carry, Ollie Gordon dominating carries and Miami's likely need to pass from behind as the game moves along, Wright doesn't offer much appeal.

Michael Wilson could play in Arizona's Week 9 matchup against Seattle despite dealing with two broken ribs. The wideout suffered the injury this past Sunday in a win over Dallas, but he returned to the game after getting hurt and finished with eight catches for 111 yards and one touchdown on 15 targets. Wilson thrived with both Jacoby Brissett and Gardner Minshew under center, so the switch to Minshew as the Cardinals' starting QB shouldn't impact Wilson's production if he's able to suit up in Week 9. However, the ribs issue plus a stout Seattle pass defense that has given up the fewest fantas

news.text: The Cardinals placed Wilson (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.. Wilson's move to IR was merely a formality, after head coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday that the wideout would be sidelined for the rest of the season after sustaining a fractured vertebra in his neck during Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Seahawks. Per Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com, Wilson is expected to be in a neck brace for the next six weeks to two months, but the Cardinals don't view the injury as a long-term or career-threatening concern. The 26-year-old receiver will finish the 2026 campaign with 51 receptions for 546 yards and two touchdowns on 88 targets to go with 28 rushing yards on three carries across his nine appearances

players.outlook: Xavier Worthy could be in danger of vanishing from the Kansas City game plan. In a Week 10 win over the Falcons that marked the debut of trade-deadline acquisition Josh Downs, Worthy registered only three targets and failed to catch any. Downs, meanwhile, caught four of five targets and got into the end zone despite playing just 10 snaps. As the former Colt's role increases, Worthy could be squeezed further for looks from Patrick Mahomes, with Rashee Rice, Travis Kelce, and the team's running backs also seemingly ahead of him in the pecking order. Wan'Dale Robinson hurt his ankle in Tennessee's Week 10 loss to the Jaguars. It remains to be seen if one, both, or neither of Robinson or Carnell Tate (shoulder) will be available to face the Cowboys in Week 11. Whichever wideouts earn the majority of playing time for the Titans in Week 11 could thrive against a Dallas secondary that's giving up 158 yards and a receiving touchdown per game to WRs. news.text: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.. Meanwhile Carnell Tate (shoulder) is slated to practice this week, and his potential return to action this weekend against Dallas figures to impact the playing time of Elic Ayomanor and Chimere Dike. Robinson's looming absence will free up snaps/targets in the slot, with Saleh noting Wednesday that he's looking forward to seeing what rookie slot option Xavier Restrepo can do with added opportunities going forward.

players.outlook: Kimani Vidal nearly disappeared from the Chargers' game plan in their first win of the season. During a Week 10 win over the Ravens, he gained zero yards on two carries while catching both his targets for 14 yards, his lowest touch volume since Week 3. Omarion Hampton, meanwhile, broke out for 105 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, potentially ending the team's backfield committee. Vidal will try to make a splash in Week 11 against a Jets defense that's tied for 23rd in fantasy points per game allowed to RBs.

Mike Washington may be letting an opportunity to claim the early-down role in the Raiders' backfield slip through his fingers. Over the last two games, including a Week 10 loss to the Seahawks, the rookie running back has gained just 20 rushing yards on 14 carries. Ashton Jeanty hasn't been any better, but his receiving skills will keep him atop the depth chart for now. Washington will try to get rolling again in Week 11 against a Broncos defense that ranks 22nd in fantasy points per game allowed to RBs.

Ray Davis has not been a part of the Bills' game plan entering a Week 5 matchup with the Rams. He has only two carries through four weeks, adding one catch while factoring in on kickoff returns. Seemingly losing snaps to Ty Johnson on passing downs in what was already a limited role, Davis's only fantasy appeal would be to James Cook managers in the event of an injury.

Emanuel Wilson's role for Week 8 against the Bears could depend on whether Zach Charbonnet (knee) and/or Jadarian Price (chest) is ready to rejoin Seattle's backfield. As the Seahawks' lead RB in Week 7 against Kansas City, Wilson racked up 100 yards and a touchdown on a hearty 24 carries and added one catch for 15 yards. It was the third time over his past four contests that Wilson logged 20 or more totes, but should Charbonnet and/or Price be ready to return to the fold, Wilson will likely handle a reduced workload. Either way, he could find room to run against a Chicago defense that ranks 2

Ty Johnson isn't garnering enough volume to merit consideration for the Bills in Week 11 against the Dolphins. Known for his work as a receiver out of the backfield, Johnson collected only one catch in Week 10 with Buffalo throwing just 21 times en route to an easy victory. Miami has been vulnerable to receiving backs, allowing five touchdown catches, but Johnson seems unlikely to amass enough looks with a 25% or fewer snap share.

Samaje Perine and the Bengals travel to take on the Commanders in Week 11. He rushed six times for 14 yards and a touchdown and caught all four targets for 25 yards during Cincinnati's Week 10 victory. Perine watched as Chase Brown produced 83 yards and two TDs on 18 touches, with both backs helping the Bengals win a fifth straight game. Perine has been valuable to Cincinnati's offense, but his limited role doesn't offer fantasy upside with Brown still atop the depth chart.

Brian Robinson (hamstring) is expected to operate as the Falcons' No. 2 running back if active for the Week 9 matchup against the Bengals. Robinson has been sidelined for two consecutive games due to a hamstring issue. However, he's been an effective runner when healthy, averaging 4.0 yards per carry and rushing for four touchdowns in six appearances this season. Despite this, he'll likely need to find the end zone to be fantasy relevant against a Bengals defense that's given up just 19.7 fantasy points per game to opposing running backs this year.

news.text: Robinson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.. Robinson already has missed two games due to a lingering hamstring injury and now must miss at least the next four outings, meaning his next chance for game action is Sunday, Dec. 13 at Cleveland. In a corresponding move, the Falcons are signing Khalil Herbert from the practice squad to the active roster to continue serving as the No. 2 RB behind workhorse Bijan Robinson.

players.outlook: Marvin Harrison sat out Houston's Week 10 loss to the Browns due to a hamstring injury and is out again for Week 11 against the Colts. He won't be a trustworthy fantasy option for the foreseeable future while battling for targets in a deep Texans WR room that also includes Nico Collins, Tank Dell, Xavier Hutchinson and Kayshon Boutte. Harrison has 11 catches for 145 yards and two touchdowns in seven games split between the Cardinals and Texans this season.

news.text: Harrison (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Colts.. Harrison was also inactive for this past Sunday's game against the Browns, and he will now target a potential return to action Nov. 29 versus the Ravens following Houston's Week 11 bye. In his continued absence, Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte and Tank Dell will handle the Texans' WR duties Thursday. Collins (16 targets, nine catches) and Hutchinson (nine targets, four catches) combined for 152 receiving yards on the 25 targets the duo saw against Cleveland in Week 10.

players.outlook: Tyrone Tracy was the most productive back last game for the Giants, scoring one rushing and one receiving touchdown. However, he managed just 45 scrimmage yards on eight touches overall. Meanwhile, Devin Singletary had 33 yards on five touches, Najee Harris eked out just two rushing yards on four carries and Cam Skattebo did not even register a touch following last week's costly fumble. It will be hard to trust any New York running back until one emerges from the pack. In Week 7, the Giants will also face a stingy Texans run defense. news.text: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.. The Giants haven't provided any updates on Tracy since he landed on IR on Oct. 27 after sustaining a hamstring strain in a Week 7 win over the Texans, but the running back is seemingly progressing well and could be ready to play once he sits out the required four games. Once he's reinstated, Tracy could operate as a change-of-pace option behind Cam Skattebo, who appears to have reclaimed the lead role out of the New York backfield after a one-game benching in Week 6.

For starters, we haven't seen him in a while after he suffered a season-ending foot injury in Week 3 last season. Even prior to the injury, Conner was splitting work with Trey Benson, totaling 28 touches in two full games. Conner restructured his contract during the offseason, but his days as Arizona's lead back are over after Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier were added to the roster during the offseason. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.. Conner hasn't played in a game since Week 3 of last season, when he sustained a right foot/ankle injury that required surgery. Though he was able to participate in individual drills in training camp, he never advanced to team work before being placed on injured reserve with a designation to return Aug. 30. players.outlook: Seth McGowan set career highs with 12 carries and 77 rushing yards in the Colts' Week 10 win over the Dolphins while scoring a touchdown for the second consecutive game. Indianapolis has deployed McGowan as the 1B option behind Jonathan Taylor over the past couple of weeks, and the rookie seventh-round pick is quietly averaging an impressive 5.2 yards per carry in his young career. McGowan has yet to catch multiple passes in a game and has just nine career receiving yards, so he'll be tough to trust as a flex option, even in deeper formats, until he shows more receiving capabilities. news.text: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.. McGowan was injured just before halftime while returning a kickoff. He was deemed questionable to return at the beginning of the third quarter and subsequently was ruled out shortly thereafter. The rookie running back gained seven yards on three carries and caught his only target for one yard before exiting while adding 117 yards on three kickoff returns. Jonathan Taylor should continue to get most of the work at running back for the Colts for the rest of the game, and DJ Giddens should handle whatever backfield snaps that Taylor doesn't get.

players.outlook: Antonio Williams found the end zone last game for Washington. The rookie snagged two passes for 42 yards and a touchdown in the 24-21 win over the G-Men. Williams has at least two catches in every game this season, and should continue to see steady work in the absence of Terry McLaurin. However, in Week 11, he will be facing a Bengals defense allowing just 216.2 passing yards per tilt, which is 11th in the league. In addition, Cincy has yielded just 11 passing scores, which is tied for fifth in the NFL.

Brenton Strange remains a borderline fantasy starter at TE for Week 11 against the Giants. He scored his first TD since Week 1 in Jacksonville's Week 10 win over the Titans but had just nine receiving yards, dropping his season average to 41 yards per game. That's right in line with the 48 receiving yards per game that the Giants allow to TEs, as they are a better-than-average defense against the position.
